# Pull Request Guidelines

## Branch Policy & Code Review Rules
- Direct pushes to `main` branch are strictly prohibited.
- All code changes, bug fixes, and feature additions must be submitted via Pull Requests (PR).
- PRs must pass automated build checks and test suites before merging.

---

### PR Checklist
- [ ] Code follows existing project architecture and coding standards.
- [ ] No syntax errors, and builds cleanly without warnings.
- [ ] Tested manually and with automated unit tests (if applicable).
- [ ] Preserved documentation integrity and updated relevant API docs.
